evidence: Clicking "New Resume" opened editor titled "Untitled Resume" with empty Contact fields and tabs for Summary/Experience/Education/Skills ready for editing.

Date inputs are type=month; preview renders "Jan 2020 - Jun 2023" and "Jul 2023 - Present". Checking "I currently work here" cleared the previously entered end date (2024-05 -> "") and set the input disabled.

issue: No date-period validation on experience entries
actual: With start date Jan 2020, setting end date to Jan 2019 (before start) was accepted silently and preview showed "Jan 2020 - Jan 2019". Setting a future end date 2030-05 was also accepted ("Jan 2020 - May 2030"); month inputs have no max attribute and no error message or feedback appeared anywhere on the page.

evidence: Contact fields + summary entered and reflected in preview. Experience: added 2 entries, edited them, reordered via ↑ (Beta Inc moved above Acme Corp, preview updated), added and deleted a 3rd entry. Education: added 2, reordered, deleted one. Skills: added Playwright & Test Automation, changed level to Expert, removed a skill successfully.
Every field edit (name, email, summary, experience, education, skills) appeared in the Live Preview panel immediately with no save/refresh action.

Template tab offers Modern, Classic, Minimal. Switching Modern→Classic→Minimal→Modern changed preview styling (serif/uppercase for Classic, light/tracking for Minimal) while all content (contact, summary, 2 experiences, education, skills) remained intact.

Sections tab: moving Skills up changed preview order to Summary/Experience/Skills/Education; toggling Education switch off removed the Education section (and its content) from the preview, toggling on restored it.

issue: Custom summary section heading not rendered in Minimal template
actual: Section headings were renamed to "About Me", "Career History", "Core Skills", "Academics". Modern and Classic previews show all four custom headings. In the Minimal template the preview renders only CAREER HISTORY, CORE SKILLS and ACADEMICS — the summary section (still visible/enabled) shows its text with no "About Me" heading at all.

evidence: Modern preview renders all visible sections with content (contact header, About Me, Career History with both jobs, Core Skills, Academics). After adding a very long description the preview grew beyond the viewport (document scrollHeight 1130 vs viewport 720) and the full content including the last section was reachable by scrolling.

"Hide Preview" removed the Live Preview panel (button became "Show Preview"); editor data intact. "Show Preview" restored the preview with the same Modern template rendering, custom headings and all content.

issue: No validation feedback when renaming to empty/whitespace title
actual: Renaming the resume title to "" and to "   " (Enter to confirm) correctly kept the previous title "Untitled Resume", but no error message, toast, or any other feedback was rendered (MutationObserver over 1.5s captured only the reverted title node); the invalid input is silently discarded.

evidence: Renamed to "QA Engineer Resume"; editor header shows "QA Engineer Resume" and the dashboard card heading shows the same title.

After switching editor tabs, returning to dashboard and reopening the resume, contact fields (Jane Tester/jane@test.com/phone/Austin, TX/linkedin/website), summary, both experience entries, education (State University, BS CS, GPA 3.7, Sep 2012 - May 2016) and skills (Playwright, Test Automation) were all still present.

Section reorder (Skills above Education) and visibility toggle updated the preview immediately; after navigating tabs, hiding/showing preview, going to dashboard and reopening the resume, the preview still shows order About Me → Career History → Core Skills → Academics.

No manual save exists; edits made across Contact/Summary/Experience/Education/Skills/Template/Sections tabs were all retained after returning to the dashboard and reopening. Dashboard card shows "Updated Aug 28, 2026" (today) reflecting the update.

issue: Whitespace-only title accepted by dashboard rename dialog; no validation feedback anywhere
actual: Dashboard card menu → Rename → entered "   " → Save: the dialog closed and the resume card title became blank (empty heading), i.e. the whitespace title was saved with no validation error. In the editor header the same input silently reverts to the old title with no error message/toast (MutationObserver over 1.5s captured no feedback).

evidence: Card menu → Duplicate created "QA Engineer Resume (Copy)" with identical content; renamed it to "Product QA Resume" via the rename dialog; edited name/summary in the copy while the source "QA Engineer Resume" kept its own content.

Copy edited to "Jane Copy-Tester" + "COPY SUMMARY..." → original still showed "Jane Tester" and the original summary. Then original edited to "Jane Original" → copy still shows "Jane Copy-Tester" and its own summary.

Dashboard holds 6 distinct resumes in-session (Data Analyst Application, Product QA Resume, QA Engineer Resume + 3 seeded). Each opens with its own independent content; created, duplicated and renamed variations coexist.

issue: No date filtering capability on the dashboard
actual: Dashboard controls consist only of a "Search resumes..." text input and a sort dropdown (Newest/Oldest First, Title A-Z/Z-A). There is no exact-date or date-range filter control (no date inputs exist in main). Entering a date "Feb 10, 2024" into the search box yields "No resumes found", so dates cannot be used to narrow resumes at all.

evidence: Search "qa" (lowercase) matched "Product QA Resume" and "QA Engineer Resume"; "MARKETING" (uppercase) matched "Marketing Manager Resume" — case-insensitive. Sort "Newest First" listed Aug 28 2026 items first down to Jan 20 2024; "Oldest First" reversed the order. Clearing the search restored all 6 resumes.

issue: No persistence across reload — all resume changes are lost
actual: Before reload the dashboard held 5 resumes: created "QA Engineer Resume" and "Data Analyst Application", duplicate renamed to "Product QA Resume", and deleted "Software Engineer Resume". localStorage was empty. After reloading http://localhost:6005/, the dashboard shows only the 3 original seeded resumes (Product Designer, Marketing Manager, Software Engineer) — created/edited/duplicated/renamed resumes vanished and the deleted resume reappeared.
